import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(77)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (4, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['value'] = np.where(np.arange(n) % 2 == 0, rng.uniform(0, 1, n), rng.uniform(9, 10, n))
df['label'] = [f'item_{i:04d}' for i in range(n)]

steps.name: set title column to label, search for 'item_' (all 3000 items match)
steps.eval: const labelCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'label'); a.tooltipOpts = { ...a.tooltipOpts, titleColumn: labelCol.index }; a.search('item_')

steps.name: baseline: all points highlighted – measure bright pixels
